component_findings.artifact_source_separation: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Source-level program meaning is not unnecessarily tied to a single compiler ABI, filesystem convention or host-specific build assumption. Evidence basis: Current architecture keeps semantics in the frontend and typed IR, treats LLVM as an implementation target, specifies numeric/storage semantics independently of host details and centralizes platform declarations; platform abstraction/conditional mechanisms remain less complete than the strongest mature multi-target designs. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Source-level program meaning is not unnecessarily tied to a single compiler ABI, filesystem convention or host-specific build assumption. Evidence basis: Current architecture keeps semantics in the frontend and typed IR, treats LLVM as an implementation target, specifies numeric/storage semantics independently of host details and centralizes platform declarations; platform abstraction/conditional mechanisms remain less complete than the strongest mature multi-target designs.
